title: How it Was Already Evident By March Of 2020 That COVID-19 Was A Farce - COVID Was Put Into Play In Order To Accomplish Certain Social, Economic, And Political Objectives
text:
by Anthony Emmanuelli, All News Pipeline :
PERTINENT QUOTES
This statement was made by one of the rare, and honest, scientists who risked all to tell the truth during the COVID-19 psych-op. The end game was revealed:
“COVID-19 was put into play in order to accomplish certain social, economic, and political objectives. It never had anything to do with public health or public welfare. It never has and it never will.”
This next quote is one I picked up somewhere off the Internet recently, and all credit goes to the one who came up with it. It is brilliant in terms of its truth and simplicity, and so it reads:
“The more power that is given to politicians in the event of an emergency, the more emergencies politicians will create in order to gain more power.”
TRUTH LIVES on at https://sgtreport.tv/
This last quote is one that most Americans have heard before (whether they wanted to or not), and that famous statement is:
“The nine most terrifying words in the English language are: I’m from the government and I’m here to help.”
THE THREE VILLAINS
There were many parties involved in the phenomenon we know as COVID-19, but in order to understand its nefarious nature from the start, only three parties needed to be identified back in March of 2020: just three . I call them “the three villains”. They are:
Xi Jingping, General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party (the CCP), Chairman of the People’s Republic of China;
Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus (aka Tedros), Director-General of the World Health Organization (or WHO), and,
Anthony Fauci (and everyone knows who he is).
As part of the process of digging through and exposing COVID-19 for what it was, it became necessary to associate: Tedros to Xi Jingping, and Fauci to Tedros, so that Tedros, by default, becomes the centerpiece for the entire operation.
THE CONFERENCE
 Early in January of 2020, rumors were already starting to swirl concerning “coronavirus”: a mysterious illness originating from China which was already spreading to other parts of the world (mainly Southeast Asia), and was both highly transmittable and lethal. Videos coming out of China at that time were depicting people “dropping dead” on the streets from what would later be called “COVID-19”. The videos served as a powerful distraction from moves that were being conducted behind the scenes by major players who stood to gain from the spread of the virus. Rather than the hypnotic focus on these videos, this is the photo which should have served as a forewarning that serious developments were about to take place around the world:
 This picture was taken on January 28th, 2020, in Beijing. This was no ordinary meeting between two individuals in positions of global power. Here’s Xi Jingping, the ruler of the country from which the worldwide threat would originate, and here’s Tedros, the head of the WHO who would soon issue “health” recommendations, and proclamations, to countries throughout the world.
The timing is also important: it took place one month to the day before Italy started the process of locking down, and roughly six weeks before strict lockdowns were instituted in the United States (and elsewhere). Indeed, Tedros and his WHO would declare this coronavirus a “Public Health Emergency of International Concern” two days after this meeting, on the 30th.
This conference on January 28th, 2020 is one of the most important that has ever occurred between two leaders in modern history (if not world history), yet most people around the globe are unaware that this conference ever happened . In spite of the power of the two people involved (and the timing of it), this meeting was scarcely reported by the global news media at all, especially in the West, and should have been, considering the suffering and the misery that was soon to envelop Planet Earth over the next few months (and years).
